tests.title: same-page birth assessment reads matching annual and period passages, scores once and clears its session
same-page assessment ignores an older real scoring response after birth inputs create a new session
current teaching view keeps other stages folded and exposes original excerpts and relationship sources by keyboard
birth comparison submits only requested precision, displays both contexts and clears edited personal data
constitution workflow keeps the current context, prevents partial scoring and shows all nine independent results
current-year shortcut and adjacent-year controls retain URL, bounds and history
mobile stage selection keeps all six choices beside nearby detail and preserves exact time descriptions
sticky navigation, skip link and technical disclosure support keyboard recovery
current route redirects, renders canonical time and closes every stage disclosure
annual entry, real year query, six-stage keyboard selection, history, reload and return form a loop
invalid year abc shows a recoverable message without a business query
invalid year 2024extra shows a recoverable message without a business query
invalid year 1899 shows a recoverable message without a business query
invalid year 2101 shows a recoverable message without a business query
specified time is submit-only, rejects empty input and hides stale results after editing
supported annual boundary years load directly from the real API
a real unsupported calculation receives sanitized feedback and recovers after editing
pending calculation disables input and repeated activation sends only one real request
calculation outage is sanitized and retry recovers using the real API
/yunqi/current recovers after a single failed GET
/yunqi/year/2024 recovers after a single failed GET
inquiry remains a no-query planning entry and invalid child routes return to current
